text:
Bea: did a fresh a11y sweep of the Dashboard header + Runs table. A mix of low-lift fixes and 2 medium items. Dropping notes.
Omar: thanks, TL;DR?
Bea: 1) header skip link disappears after first use (we re-render it during the slide-down), 2) streaming announcer reads every chunk -> noisy, 3) compact icon buttons have no visible focus in dark mode, 4) action flyout steals focus during animation.
Priya: can you paste repro + tiny fixes?
Bea: repro skip: activate "Skip to runs" then tab back: link gone. Fix: keep skip node in DOM, toggle `.is-hidden` and keep `tabindex=0` and `aria-controls="runs-table"`.
Bea: announcer: currently `div[aria-live="polite"]` updated per token. NVDA/VO read every change. Proposal: debounce to 500ms and only announce state changes (started/paused/complete) or quarter increments. Use `role="status" aria-atomic="true"`. Add enterprise flag for verbose announcements.
Sam: flyout focus: on open we animate then set focus to overlay — that timing hides trigger outline. Fix: call `trigger.classList.add('focus-persist')` before animation or `trigger.focus()` immediately and move overlay focus after. Also ensure Esc returns focus to trigger.
Omar: focus styles: use `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset:2px }` for icon-only buttons; prefer brand-blue token in dark theme and add prefers-contrast fallback.
a11y-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2261234567 — Contrast: WARN (pill hover), Focus-visible: FAIL (icon-btns), LiveRegion: FAIL (too frequent).
Priya: prioritize: 1) stabilize skiplink + tests (low) 2) announcer debounce + feature flag (med) 3) focus-visible CSS (low) 4) flyout focus handoff (low).
Omar: I'll open PR for 1+3 today with unit + keyboard e2e tests. Sam: can you pair on announcer next sprint and run NVDA/VO smoke tests?
Sam: yes, will verify and add a test that tabs twice through header to ensure skiplink persists.
Bea: linking notes and screenshots to backlog: https://redwood-infra/board/999 — added acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark:
